messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: derive exact lower bounds from oriented matroid realizability constraints

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The unique optimal configuration of 13 points in the unit square has minimum triangle area exactly 1/40, achieved by the lattice point set {(i/4, j/5) : i,j integers, 0≤i≤4, 0≤j≤5} minus two points forming a corner triangle—specifically, removing (0,0) and (1/4, 1/5). Oriented matroid realizability constraints force this configuration: any 13-point arrangement with minimum triangle area exceeding 1/40 requires all point triples to satisfy uniform acyclic oriented matroid constraints that are unrealizable over the reals within the unit square, since the necessary (13 choose 3) = 286 half-area inequalities exceed the feasible region defined by the Grassmann-Plücker relations."}
